Projects & Tableau

Featured marketing work

Audience: seniors and family caregivers in Orange County

Brand awareness graphic

“Amada Means Beloved”

Designed an educational social media post that explains the meaning behind the Amada name and connects the brand to compassionate care.

  • Created a clear headline and supporting message for a quick-read format.
  • Used warm imagery, brand colors, and a direct visual hierarchy.
  • Included the Orange County brand identity for local relevance.

FAQ content series

Personalized care FAQ

Created a single-image FAQ post that answers a common family question and invites the audience to share what matters most.

  • Turned a service question into concise, accessible copy.
  • Used a conversational call to action to encourage engagement.
  • Built a repeatable format for future FAQ posts.
